literal: Measure having known he who does not live's life, existing like, having become nothing, without appearing will perish.
translation: The life of one who does not live knowing the measure of his resources will seem to exist, but will become nothing and perish without a trace.
modern: தன் செல்வத்தின் அளவை அறிந்து வாழாதவனின் வாழ்க்கை, இருப்பது போலத் தோன்றி, உண்மையில் இல்லாமல் ஆகி சுவடு தெரியாமல் அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against living beyond one's means. The word 'aḷavu' refers to the measure or limit of one's wealth and resources. If a person does not understand this limit and live accordingly, their life might look prosperous on the outside. However, their resources will silently drain away, and they will eventually be ruined without leaving a trace.
